tools.name: meal_search
tools.description: Search for meals/recipes by name. Returns matching meals with their category, area (cuisine), thumbnail, and a list of ingredients. Use for questions like 'find me a chicken tikka masala recipe' or 'how do I make lasagna'. Also use for browsing meal categories or getting a random meal suggestion.

query.description: Meal name to search for, e.g. 'chicken tikka', 'lasagna', 'pad thai'. Use 'random' for a random meal suggestion.

tools.name: meal_by_ingredient
tools.description: Find meals that can be made with a specific main ingredient. Use for questions like 'what can I make with chicken' or 'I have salmon, what recipes can I cook'.

ingredient.description: A main ingredient to search by, e.g. 'chicken_breast', 'salmon', 'pasta', 'rice'

tools.name: meal_detail
tools.description: Get full cooking instructions and the complete ingredient list with measurements for a specific meal. Use after `meal_search` when the user wants the full recipe.

meal_id.description: The meal ID returned by meal_search, e.g. '52772'

tools.name: meal_plan
tools.description: Generate a random weekly meal plan. Creates a plan with random meals assigned to each day and meal slot (breakfast/lunch/dinner by default). Use for questions like 'plan my meals this week', 'what should I eat this week', or 'give me a 5-day meal plan'.

days.description: Number of days to plan for (1-14, default 7)

meals_per_day.description: Number of meals per day (1-5, default 3: breakfast, lunch, dinner)

tools.name: shopping_list
tools.description: Generate a categorized shopping list from meal IDs. Takes comma-separated meal IDs and returns ingredients grouped by category (Produce, Dairy, Meat, Bakery, Pantry, Other) with merged quantities. Use after meal_plan or meal_search to get a consolidated shopping list.

meal_ids.description: Comma-separated list of meal IDs, e.g. '52772,52807,52940'
